sections.html:
Merrillville is a town in Ross Township, Lake County, in the Chicago metropolitan area of Northwest Indiana. It is centered on the crossing of Interstate 65 and U.S. Route 30 and covers about 33.3 square miles, almost all of it land.

Neighbors include Gary, Hobart, Winfield, Crown Point, Schererville and Griffith. The elevation is about 679 feet.

The 2020 census counted 36,444 residents, up from 35,246 in 2010 and 30,560 in 2000. The Census Bureau's 2025 estimate is 37,407. In January 2015 Merrillville became the most populous town in Indiana, and it is still run as a town, with a town manager rather than a mayor.

The land was Potawatomi woodland until a clearing known as McGwinn Village appeared in 1834. Jeremiah Wiggins settled there in 1835, and the site became Wiggins Point, a stop on the Sauk Trail for wagon trains.

The place was renamed Centerville and later Merrillville, for brothers Dudley and William Merrill. Ross Township was formed in 1848 from nearby settlements.

Merrillville was incorporated as a town in 1971, with growth driven largely by residents leaving Gary. In 1993 Winfield residents blocked an annexation attempt by incorporating their own town. Two National Register sites remain, the Morgan-Skinner-Boyd Homestead and the John Wood Old Mill.

sections.h2: What is Lake County like around Merrillville?
sections.html:
Lake County is Indiana's second most populous county, with 498,700 residents in 2020, and the second largest by total area at about 626.6 square miles. It has 19 incorporated cities and towns, and Hammond is the largest by population at 77,879.

The county borders Lake Michigan to the north and includes part of the Indiana Dunes. Its highest point, 801 feet, is in northeastern Winfield Township, close to Merrillville, and the lowest, 585 feet, is on the lake shoreline.

I-65 is the Casimir Pulaski Memorial Highway through the county, and U.S. 30 follows the historic Lincoln Highway, whose original alignment in Merrillville is 73rd Avenue. The Lake County Public Library Central Library stands at 1919 West 81st Avenue. These county facts matter to a seller because the county, not the town, handles your tax bill and deed.

sections.h2: What does the Merrillville economy look like?
sections.html:
Merrillville is a retail hub for Northwest Indiana. The U.S. 30 corridor between Taft Street and Colorado Street is lined with big-box stores, hotels, restaurants and car dealers.

  • Ameriplex at the Crossroads, an industrial and technology park, opened in 2005 on Broadway between 93rd and 101st Avenues.
  • NiSource, a Fortune 500 energy company, has its headquarters in town.
  • White Lodging, a hospitality management firm, is based here.
  • Centier Bank, Indiana's largest privately owned independent bank, is also headquartered here.

Unlike much of Lake County, heavy industry such as steelmaking and refining is not significant inside Merrillville itself. At the county level, manufacturing was the largest employment sector in 2010, followed by healthcare and social assistance, and the county's economy was built on steel.

sections.h2: How do you get around Merrillville?
sections.html:
I-65 and U.S. 30 meet in the middle of town, and U.S. 30 is part of the historic Lincoln Highway, called 81st Avenue locally. State Road 53 runs along Broadway and State Road 55 along Taft Street, both north to south.

  • Airports: Griffith-Merrillville Airport in Griffith and Gary/Chicago International Airport in Gary.
  • Transit: Barons Bus Lines and the Gary Public Transportation Corporation's Broadway Metro Express.
  • Rail: the South Shore Line in downtown Gary, with the nearest Amtrak station in Dyer.

sections.h2: What weather should a Merrillville homeowner expect?
sections.html:
Merrillville has warm summers and cold winters. July highs run around 85 degrees F with lows near 62, and January highs near 32 with lows around 15. Monthly precipitation ranges from about 1.4 inches in February to 4.1 inches in September.

Lake County sits on the Valparaiso Moraine, borders Lake Michigan and gets added winter snow from lake effect. Roofs, gutters, sump pumps and heating systems do most of the work in this climate, and deferred maintenance shows up fast.

The Merrillville Community School Corporation serves all of Ross Township. That covers the entire town of Merrillville, the part of Crown Point north of 101st Avenue and the part of Hobart south of 61st Avenue.

  • Merrillville High School
  • Clifford Pierce Middle School, grades 5 and 6
  • Merrillville Intermediate School, grades K to 4
  • Elementary schools named Henry P. Fieler, Homer Iddings, Edgar L. Miller and Jonas E. Salk
  • John Wood Elementary School, in Hobart

Andrean High School, a Roman Catholic school run by the Diocese of Gary, is also in Merrillville.

sections.h2: What are Merrillville's building and rental rules?
sections.html:
The Planning and Building Department enforces the town's building codes and zoning ordinances. It is at 7820 Broadway, Merrillville, IN 46410, with a department phone of 219-769-3631 and a town main line of 219-769-5711.

The town's documents page lists a rental registration application, along with contractor applications, variance applications and subdivision forms. If you rent out the house you plan to sell, ask the department whether your registration is current before closing.

Permit details, fees and certificate of occupancy rules were not posted on the pages we reviewed, so call the department for the current steps on your address.

sections.h2: When are Lake County property taxes due, and how do tax sales work?
sections.html:
Indiana Code 6-1.1-22-9 sets two installments, May 10 and November 10 of the following year. The Lake County Treasurer is in Crown Point, and the Auditor's tax sales office is at 2293 North Main Street, Building A, 2nd Floor, phone 219-755-3155, open weekdays 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.

The Treasurer's 2026 tax sale ran online at zeusauction.com from Friday, September 4 through Tuesday, September 8, 2026, with registration at $100. If a house you own has fallen behind on taxes, that calendar matters for the timing of a sale.

sections.h2: How are deeds handled in Lake County?
sections.html:
The seller and buyer complete a sales disclosure form under Indiana Code 6-1.1-5.5-3 before the deed goes to the auditor, and the county assessor must approve the form first. One form covers contiguous parcels in the same taxing district on a single deed.

The county seat is Crown Point, chosen in 1840. A title company usually handles the filing for you.

sections.h2: What do Merrillville sellers usually face?
sections.html:
Many owners sell because of a move, an inheritance, rental trouble or repair costs. The 2020 census page lists about 14.5 percent of residents below the poverty line, so some owners are carrying a house that needs work on a tight budget.

  • Listing means prep, showings and waiting on a buyer's financing and inspection.
  • A cash purchase takes the house as it stands.
  • The closing date is yours to set.

Compare net proceeds, timing and effort across the options before you decide.

faqs.q: Is Merrillville a city or a town?
faqs.a: Merrillville is a town in Lake County, governed under Indiana law with a town manager. It was incorporated in 1971 and is the most populous town in Indiana.
Lake County, whose county seat is Crown Point. Merrillville is in Ross Township.

faqs.q: Do Merrillville landlords have to register rentals?
faqs.a: The town's planning and building documents page lists a rental registration application. Call the department at 219-769-3631 to confirm current requirements.

faqs.q: When are property taxes due in Lake County?
faqs.a: State law sets May 10 and November 10. The county treasurer posts the exact schedule and payment options.
The Merrillville Community School Corporation, which serves Ross Township including all of the town.

faqs.q: Can I sell my Merrillville house as-is?
faqs.a: Yes. A cash buyer can purchase it without repairs, and you choose the closing date.
